neutralAnswers.rationale: Educated assumption: Parliamentary removal powers are constitutional counterevidence, but dominant-party control and restricted opposition weaken their independent use against serious leadership abuse. A mixed response is retained for the real parliamentary mechanism and its practical dependence, rather than affirming an effective check. Exact behaviour in a future confidence confrontation is uncertain. This interprets implemented institutions, not an official questionnaire response; the exact normative preference is inferred.
